# Assumption of Moses Chapter 12 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Latin palimpsest (Codex Ambrosianus) | **Section:** Moses Comforts Joshua

---

**12:1** And Moses heard him and comforted him and said to him:

**12:2** Joshua, do not despair on account of your people and do not be grieved on their account.

**12:3** God has foreseen all things, and he has made provision for the fulfillment of his covenant from the beginning of time.

**12:4** He created the world on their account but did not make his intention known from the beginning of the world, so that the nations might be judged and humiliated, and that his purpose might be made manifest.

**12:5** He will indeed punish them and comfort them again, when the time of his mercy comes.

**12:6** For I am going the way of all the earth, but God is faithful to his covenant.

**12:7** Look, Joshua, you know that God who created the world on behalf of his people will be a mediator and will plead for them and will regard them with his compassion.

**12:8** For he has not forgotten them, nor will he forget them forever.

**12:9** But he will come to them again in his time and will show them his mercy.

**12:10** He has appointed me to pray for their sins and to make intercession for them.

**12:11** For I am the mediator of his covenant and the prophet sent to pray for Israel.

**12:12** Go then, Joshua, in strength of soul, and serve the Lord God faithfully.

**12:13** And he chose me and appointed me as the mediator of his covenant.

**12:14** For God created the earth for the sake of his people and he will judge the whole world, punishing the wicked and comforting the righteous.

**12:15** And I, Moses, have been appointed to pray for the people and to intercede for them, and to give them the law.

**12:16** Therefore be comforted, Joshua, and serve the Lord and do his will.

**12:17** God will lead his people and will not forsake them, for he is a God of truth and faithfulness.

**12:18** And his covenant will stand forever, and his promise will be fulfilled at the appointed time.
